title: WARN server::routes::task_attempts: diff WS closed: Container ref not found for task attempt
body:
Trying it out for the first time on NixOS.

Two (or three, really) bugs so far:

1) Does not error out gracefully on install (via `npx vibe-kanban`) when `unzip` not found before erroring out. Somehow, I didn't have it installed yet.

2) The above error (in the subject line, `WARN server::routes::task_attempts: diff WS closed: Container ref not found for task attempt`) occurs as soon as I try to create a task against gpt-5 codex. And it repeats indefinitely... And shortly after that...

3) OOM error which hangs my entire machine. Sooooo maybe look into your memory leaks, please.

But hey, the UI looks great!

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue because it involves memory-related symptoms (OOM error and potential memory leaks) and issues with LLM provider integration (error occurs when creating a task against GPT-5 Codex). These align with the criteria for memory and LLM operation issues in agent systems.
